blurb: Christina's Dream Dance Studio offers dance classes including ballet, lyrical, tap, jazz, hip hop, acrobatics, Zumba, and salsa for various age groups from birth to adults. Classes focus on building technique, strength, expressiveness, and self-confidence in a positive environment. The studio also offers dance parties and seasonal camps.
